{{Quote|I had no idea how they had overpowered the Emperor, but I didn't stop to think about it, either&hellip; I didn't care. It was my job to save him.|Maarek Stele|<ref name="TF:OSG" />}}
The '''battle of Imperial Center''' took place near [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] between [[Zaarin coup forces|forces]] loyal to the rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] and those loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As part of a coup d'état against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Zaarin brought his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']], to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], catching the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] in his private [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Majestic (Imperial-class)|''Majestic'']]. Zaarin disabled the ship and boarded it, capturing Palpatine by using the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] of [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]] and her students to overcome the Emperor's own powers.

As Zaarin's [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] returned to the ''Glory'' with the captive Palpatine, a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of six [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]], led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], appeared out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Stele inspected the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and disabled the one carrying the Emperor. Zaarin responded by launching [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] to assist, but it was too late. [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] arrived in the Star Destroyer [[Vanguard (Imperial-class)|''Vanguard'']] along with the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Mescue]]''. The ''Mescue'' boarded the Emperor's shuttle and rescued him, while Stele, Vader and the remaining TIE Defenders destroyed Zaarin's TIE Avengers. Zaarin saw that his coup had failed and left the Coruscant [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the ''Glory''.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It seems as if Zaarin has developed some dangerous plans, and we believe the Emperor to be in great danger. I want you to join me, Colonel, on an urgent mission. You have trained in the new starfighter. I want you to accompany me and break through Zaarin's lines. I must get to Coruscant immediately.|Darth Vader, to Maarek Stele|<ref name="TF:OSG" />}}
[[File:Arden_Lyn_and_Zaarin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Arden Lyn and Demetrius Zaarin]]
Shortly after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] victory over the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="TF" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], head of the Empire's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE starfighter series]] research and development, plotted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and assume the Imperial throne.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|366|Zaarin, Grand Admiral Demetrius}}</ref> Around the same time, Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] defected to the Rebellion along with his [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]]. The Empire began a [[Battle for Honor|campaign]] to capture the rogue admiral, led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="TF" /> who was also engaged in a personal vendetta against [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], head of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="NEC" />

With Vader preoccupied, Zaaring finalized his own plans.<ref name="NEC" /> While openly supporting the hunt for Harkov,<ref name="CSWE" /> the Grand Admiral sought to draw like-minded personnel within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to his personal command,<ref name="TF:OSG" /> and recruited [[Arden Lyn]] as his agent on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]],<ref name="Insider66">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> the Imperial capital [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="TF" /> Lyn, an ancient practitioner of the martial art [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|teräs käsi]], and a member of the Emperor's elite cadre of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users known as the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], had herself decided to turn against Palpatine shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] [[0 ABY/Legends|three years earlier]], after the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] failed to deliver on his promise to resurrect her deceased lover, [[Xendor]].<ref name="Gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

Immediately after Xizor was killed in [[Battle over Coruscant|battle]] against Vader around 3.5 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> the Dark Lord discovered that the remnants of Harkov's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] had fled to the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]<ref name="TF" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and traveled there aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] to oversee its destruction.<ref name="TF" /> Seeing his opportunity, Zaarin began to move his own fleet to Imperial Center.<ref name="CSWE" /> Meanwhile, the Grand Admiral dispatched several [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] to the Ottega [[Star system/Legends|system]], ostensibly to reinforce Vader's own forces, but with orders to [[Battle of Ottega|attack]] the ''Garrett'' upon arrival. Though the ''Garrett'' survived the attack, it suffered critical damage. With the ''Garrett'' unable to return to Imperial Center in time to stop Zaarin's coup, Vader selected [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to lead a [[Flight group/Legends|group]] of prototype [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] on a mission to stop any attack on the Emperor, taking one of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] for himself. Despite an [[Battle of Parmel|ambush]] by Zaarin's forces in the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]] the TIE Defender group was able to rendezvous with the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Osprey]]'', before proceeding on to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].<ref name="TF" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Mayday! Mayday! This is the Star Destroyer ''Majestic'', we have been boarded by Imperial traitors.|Distress signal from the ''Majestic''|audio=MajesticMayday-TF.flac|<ref name="TF" />}}
[[File:Haven_es.jpg|thumb|right|270px|''Haven 3'' is disabled by Maarek Stele in a TIE/D Defender.]]
Bringing his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']], to the Coruscant system, Zaarin caught the Emperor in his private [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer [[Majestic (Imperial-class)|''Majestic'']].<ref name="TF" /> With Lyn's assistance, Zaarin was able to catch Palpatine unaware<ref name="NEC" /> and his forces disabled and boarded the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="TF" /> With the help of her students, the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[17786]],<ref name="BT:AHotE">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Lyn used her [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to nullify the Emperor's own powers and he was taken into custody.<ref name="Insider66" />

Vader and Stele soon entered the system with their TIE Defender group and promptly received a distress signal from the ''Majestic''. Moving toward the ship, the group detected the launch of six [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] from [[Haven group|Haven]] and [[Hellcat]] groups, carrying the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] from Zaarin's boarding party, along with the captive Palpatine. As they moved to intercept, Vader instructed Stele to identify the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] carrying the Emperor.<ref name="TF" /> After determining that Palpatine was aboard ''[[Haven 3]]'', Stele joined his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaging]] the other shuttles, choosing to leave Palpatine's shuttle until it could be disabled without fear of damage. Once they were destroyed, Stele dispatched his group toward the waiting ''Glory'' while he used his [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to disable ''Haven 3''.<ref name="TF:OSG" />

[[File:Mescue_mcrv.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The ''Mescue'' docks with ''Haven 3''.]]
With Palpatine's shuttle disabled, the loyal Imperial ''Assassin''-class corvette ''[[Mescue]]'' arrived in the area to board the vessel and rescue the Emperor. At around the same time, the badly damaged ''Majestic'' was able to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. With the situation turning against him, Zaarin responded by launching [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] to assist, but Stele's group moved to engage them. The TIE Defenders eliminated the attacking TIEs, losing all but Stele and Vader in the process. Around the same time, [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] arrived in the ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer [[Vanguard (Imperial-class)|''Vanguard'']] to assist the Imperial forces and began launching [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] to attack the ''Glory''. Around ten minutes after Vader's group arrived, Palpatine was safely aboard the ''Mescue'' and Stele joined the TIE bomber attack on the ''Glory''. Seeing that his coup had failed, Zaarin fled into hyperspace. Palpatine was taken to a secret location while Imperial forces planned their pursuit of Zaarin.<ref name="TF:OSG" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We are here to honor one who has served the Empire.|Emperor Palpatine awards Stele the Emperor's Will|audio=Palpy.flac|<ref name="TF" />}}
[[File:SteleAward2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Maarek Stele is awarded the Emperor's Will.]]
The Emperor had been rescued but both Zaarin and Lyn had escaped.<ref name="TF:OSG" /><ref name="Gamer5" /> Stele was rewarded for his part in rescuing the Emperor in a ceremony attended by the cream of Coruscant society<ref name="TF:OSG" /> at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. As the Emperor watched from high above, Stele was presented with the [[Emperor's Will (medal)/Legends|Emperor's Will]] medal<ref name="TF" /> by Lord Vader.<ref name="TF:OSG" /> The Emperor continued to take great interest in Stele, instructing the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Emperor]] to train Stele in the Force, and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] went on to become an Emperor's Hand.<ref name="Gamer5" />

Thrawn pursued Zaarin into hyperspace<ref name="TF" /> and began a [[Zaarin insurrection|long campaign]] to defeat the rogue Imperial, who focused on gaining technological superiority with starfighters, first by [[Attack on Omar|attacking]] TIE Avenger [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|manufacturing facilities]] in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]], before Thrawn drove him to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TF:DE" /> and eventually the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Zaarin later made a [[Second battle of Imperial Center|second unsuccessful attempt]] on Palpatine's life, before he was ultimately [[Destruction of the Glory|defeated]] by Thrawn.<ref name="TFCD">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter Collector's CD-ROM|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' Collector's CD-ROM]]</ref> Thrawn was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of Grand Admiral, taking Zaarin's place in the circle of twelve.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

The task of hunting Lyn was given to [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]].<ref name="Gamer5" /> With the failure of the coup, Lyn released Thok from her service<ref name="BT:AHotE" /> and began searching for the [[Kashi Mer talisman]], a relic which she believed could assist her in her continuing attempts to bring Xendor back to life.<ref name="Gamer5" /> She was eventually killed by Palpatine in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="EGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

The battle was included in a [[The Essential Chronology|chronicle of galactic history]] by the [[New Republic]] [[Historical Council]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> and its [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|updated edition]] in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Lyn's betrayal of Palpatine is another new wrinkle, and an example of how Star Wars continuity works best, in my opinion.|Abel G. Peña|<ref name="Abel">{{Blog|abelgpena|84|The Emperor's Pawns Endnotes, Part 4: Mistress of Teräs Käsi}}</ref>}}
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']],<ref name="TF" /> in which players fly as Maarek Stele.<ref name="TF:OSG" /> The battle is depicted in the mission "Save the Emperor," the fifth and final mission of the game's seventh tour of duty, "[[Treachery at Ottega]]." In ''TIE Fighter'', which of the three shuttles in Haven group carries the Emperor is randomized.<ref name="TF" /> ''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' established that Palpatine was [[canon]]ically aboard ''Haven 3'' in its mission walk-through, which is presented as Stele's [[After-action report/Legends|after-action report]].<ref name="TF:OSG" />

Arden Lyn's involvement in the battle was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]] article "[[The Emperor's Pawns]]" by [[Abel G. Peña]], [[Juan Schwartz]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], which also elaborated on Stele's fate following the battle.<ref name="Gamer5" />

Abel G. Peña and [[Daniel Wallace]] wrote an article entitled "[[Dirty Dozen: The Imperial Grand Admirals]]" for ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine. After ''Star Wars Gamer'' was cancelled before the article was published, Peña and Wallace reused much of the information in the [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]] article "[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]."<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|16|Grand Admirals: What Have They Got in their Pocketsses?}}</ref> The original article includes information about the battle which was ultimately cut, indicating that Zaarin's timing was motivated partially by a desire to strike before Grand Admiral [[Martio Batch]]'s [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] project took away his technological advantage, and that Lyn was not alone in pacifying the Emperor but was aided by her pupils.<ref name="DD">"[[Dirty Dozen: The Imperial Grand Admirals]]"</ref> Lyn's pupils, Thok and 17786, were later confirmed to have assisted her in Peña and [[Rich Handley]]'s [[2013]] article ''[[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]]''.<ref name="BT:AHotE" />
